# Data

Residency: All user data at rest stays in Japan (GCP asia-northeast1 / Cloudflare R2 jurisdiction default). Edge caches only public data.

| `store.domain-db` | ctr.domain-db | PostgreSQL 17 | {"automated":"daily","retained":7,"pitr_days":7,"logical_export":"weekly pg_dump → GCS (Nearline) in prod project, 35 days"} | {"rpo":"5m","rto":"60m"} | monthly, into a temporary instance inside the production project (iso.no-prod-data-downstream) |
| `store.auth-db` | ctr.auth-db | PostgreSQL 17 (same instance as store.domain-db, separate database and role) | same instance backups as store.domain-db | {"rpo":"5m","rto":"60m"} | included in store.domain-db drill |
